# nemau_subnet (Resource)

An address range inside a network.

`name` changes in place. Changing the range or the gateway replaces the subnet.

An IPv6 subnet (`ip_version = 6`) takes no `cidr` and no `gateway_ip`: the platform assigns a /64 from the region's routed prefix and its first address as the gateway, both readable once created. The network must already have an IPv4 subnet, and instances created on it afterwards get a public IPv6 address and need a security group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nemau_subnet" "app" {
  network_id = nemau_network.app.id
  name       = "app"
  cidr       = "10.0.1.0/24"
}

# An IPv6 subnet makes the network dual-stack. The platform assigns the /64,
# and the network needs its IPv4 subnet first.
resource "nemau_subnet" "app_v6" {
  network_id = nemau_network.app.id
  name       = "app-v6"
  ip_version = 6
  depends_on = [nemau_subnet.app]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Subnet name. Changes in place.
- `network_id` (String) Id of the network the subnet belongs to. Changing it replaces the subnet.

### Optional

- `cidr` (String) CIDR range, for example `10.0.1.0/24`. Required for IPv4. For IPv6 the platform assigns it, and it must not be set. An IPv4 range must not overlap any other subnet of the project, on this network or another: the subnets of a project are routed together.
- `dns_servers` (List of String) DNS resolvers announced to instances on the subnet. When omitted, the platform chooses them. Changing them replaces the subnet.
- `gateway_ip` (String) Gateway address. When omitted, the platform picks one. IPv4 only.
- `ip_version` (Number) `4` (the default) or `6`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Subnet id.

## Import

```shell
# A subnet imports by its id.
terraform import nemau_subnet.app 8d3b1f6a-9c2e-4e7b-a540-1f6e2d8c4b93
```
